decision_conditions: For the avoidance of doubt, the proposal is NOT permitted development. The proposal CONSTITUTES DEVELOPMENT within the meaning of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, and a planning application IS REQUIRED. The application site does not have permitted development rights to convert the garage which was restricted by condition no. 27C of planning permission reference 71/0749 which restricts its use to be only for the parking of motor vehicles. Therefore, the criteria laid down under Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 and any subsequent legislative amendments is restricted and planning permission is required.
description: Conversion of the existing integral garage into a habitable space with new external Changes (Front): Replacement of the existing 'up-and-over' garage door with a Wessex Cheltenham G.R.P. side-hinged garage door. External Changes (Rear): Replacement of two existing windows at the rear elevation with doors to provide garden access.
